resource: ItemInstances a creature death's loot plan may mint
allocation_impact: One MINT per accepted plan entry; a stack is one ItemInstance with a quantity, never multiple instances. Checked before the plan is returned; never truncated.
boundary_tests: max=16: a plan with 16 accepted entries (16 chance draws all succeeding) is returned
max+1=17: a plan that would accept a 17th entry is rejected
consumers: apps/game-server/src/combat/loot_plan.rs (plan_creature_loot: rejects before returning a plan with more than 16 accepted entries)
notes: D77, decision §4.1: one MINT per plan entry, a stack is one instance with quantity. Registered by OTV2-20260928-combat-d2a-loot-plan.
